questions.question: The gas responsible for the greenhouse effect is mainly:
questions.explanation: Carbon dioxide is the main greenhouse gas.

questions.question: The hardest natural substance known is:
questions.explanation: Diamond is the hardest known natural substance.

questions.question: Which international body is headquartered in Geneva, Switzerland?
questions.explanation: The WHO is headquartered in Geneva.

questions.explanation: Rajasthan is the largest Indian state by area.

questions.question: The currency of the United Kingdom is the:

questions.explanation: Jaipur is known as the Pink City.

questions.explanation: Make in India was launched in September 2014.

questions.explanation: World Environment Day is observed on 5 June.

questions.question: The "fiscal deficit" is the difference between:

options.D: Total expenditure and total receipts excluding borrowings

questions.explanation: Fiscal deficit = total expenditure − total receipts (excluding borrowings).

questions.question: The Param Vir Chakra is awarded for:
questions.explanation: The Param Vir Chakra is India’s highest wartime gallantry award.

questions.question: The SI unit of force is:
questions.explanation: Force is measured in newtons (N).

questions.explanation: The Equator divides the Earth into two hemispheres.

questions.explanation: A "googly" is a type of delivery in cricket.

questions.question: Water boils at what temperature at sea level?
questions.explanation: Water boils at 100°C at standard sea-level pressure.

questions.question: The Olympic Games are held once every how many years?
questions.explanation: The Summer Olympics are held every 4 years.

questions.question: How many players are there in a cricket team on the field?
questions.explanation: A cricket team fields 11 players.

questions.explanation: The Dandi March began on 12 March 1930.

questions.question: Which vitamin is essential for blood clotting?
questions.explanation: Vitamin K is required for blood clotting.

questions.explanation: The capital was shifted to Delhi in 1911.

questions.question: Which is the southernmost point of mainland India?
questions.explanation: Kanyakumari is the southernmost point of mainland India (Indira Point is the southernmost of Indian territory).

questions.explanation: An adult human has 206 bones.

questions.question: The financial year in India runs from:
questions.explanation: India’s financial year is April to March.

questions.question: The "Sun Temple" at Konark is located in which state?
questions.explanation: The Konark Sun Temple is in Odisha.

questions.explanation: The President appoints the Chief Justice of India.

questions.explanation: The Chandela dynasty built the Khajuraho temples.

questions.question: Who was the first woman Prime Minister of India?
questions.explanation: Indira Gandhi became PM in 1966.

questions.question: Who is the supreme commander of the Indian Armed Forces?
questions.explanation: The President is the supreme commander of the armed forces.

questions.question: Which is the lightest gas?
questions.explanation: Hydrogen is the lightest gas.

questions.explanation: It occurred at Amritsar on 13 April 1919.

questions.question: The currency of the United States is the:
questions.explanation: The US currency is the Dollar.

questions.explanation: The CAG is appointed by the President of India.

questions.question: The national animal of India is the:
questions.explanation: The Royal Bengal Tiger is India’s national animal.

questions.question: Which river is the longest in the world?
questions.explanation: The Nile is generally regarded as the longest river in the world.

questions.explanation: International Yoga Day is 21 June.

questions.explanation: Wular Lake in Jammu & Kashmir is the largest freshwater lake in India.

questions.explanation: The RBI sets the repo rate through its Monetary Policy Committee.

questions.explanation: The human heart has 4 chambers.

questions.question: The Thomas Cup is associated with which sport?
questions.explanation: The Thomas Cup is a men’s international badminton team event.

questions.question: How many players are there in a kabaddi team on the court?
questions.explanation: A kabaddi team has 7 players on the court.

questions.explanation: Jupiter is the largest planet.

questions.question: Which is the highest civilian award in India?
questions.explanation: The Bharat Ratna is the highest civilian award.

questions.explanation: Combined one-day work = 1/10 + 1/40 = 50/400. Time = 400/50 = 8 days.

questions.explanation: Area = πr² = (22/7) × 14² = 616 cm².

questions.explanation: Difference = 3 parts = 15, so each part = 5. Smaller = 2 × 5 = 10.

questions.question: A boat travels 18 km downstream in 2 hours. If the speed of the stream is 1 km/h, find the speed of the boat in still water.
questions.explanation: Downstream speed = 18/2 = 9 km/h = boat + stream. Boat = 9 − 1 = 8 km/h.

questions.explanation: Total distance = 180 + 120 = 300 m in 15 s = 20 m/s = 72 km/h.

If today is Saturday, what day will it be after 70 days?
questions.explanation: 70 mod 7 = 0; Saturday + 0 = Saturday.

questions.question: Which letter is 8th to the right of the 3rd letter from the left in the English alphabet?
questions.explanation: 3rd letter = C; 3 + 8 = 11th letter = K.

questions.question: Find the odd pair: (8, 512), (3, 27), (4, 64), (6, 221)
questions.explanation: In each correct pair the second number is the cube of the first. 6³ = 216, not 221.

questions.question: In a row of 26 students, Ravi is 16th from the left. What is his position from the right?
questions.explanation: Position from right = 26 − 16 + 1 = 11.

questions.question: Find the next term: 36, 49, 64, 81, 100, ?
questions.explanation: These are perfect squares 6²…10². Next is 11² = 121.

questions.question: Find the next term: 1, 4, 9, 16, 25, ?
questions.explanation: Differences increase by 2 each step; next difference is 11, so 25 + 11 = 36.

questions.question: If RAIN is coded as UDLQ, how is LAMP coded?
questions.explanation: Each letter is shifted forward by 3. Applying the same to LAMP gives ODPS.

questions.question: What is the angle between the hour and minute hands of a clock at 2:00?
questions.explanation: Each hour mark = 30°. At 2:00 the angle is 2 × 30° = 60°.
The relation is squaring: 6² = 36, so 4² = 16.

questions.question: A person walks 12 km East and then 16 km North. What is the shortest distance from the starting point?
questions.explanation: Shortest distance = √(12² + 16²) = √400 = 20 km.

questions.question: If + means ×, and × means −, then evaluate: 9 + 6 × 5.
questions.explanation: Replace symbols: 9 × 6 − 5 = 54 − 5 = 49.

questions.question: Find the next term: 5, 11, 23, 47, ?
questions.explanation: Each term follows ×2 + 1: 47 × 2 + 1 = 95.

questions.question: Complete the series: C, G, K, O, ?
questions.explanation: Each letter advances by 4 places, so the next is S.

questions.question: Find the odd one out: 7, 3, 2, 21
questions.explanation: 7, 2, 3 are prime numbers; 21 is a composite number.

questions.question: Which letter is 9th from the right end of the English alphabet?
questions.explanation: The 9th letter from the right is the 18th from the left = R.
The relation is cubing: 5³ = 125, so 6³ = 216.

questions.question: If today is Sunday, what day will it be after 44 days?
questions.explanation: 44 mod 7 = 2; Sunday + 2 = Tuesday.

questions.question: Which letter is 8th to the right of the 7th letter from the left in the English alphabet?
questions.explanation: 7th letter = G; 7 + 8 = 15th letter = O.

questions.question: Find the odd pair: (5, 125), (2, 8), (8, 512), (7, 342)
questions.explanation: In each correct pair the second number is the cube of the first. 7³ = 343, not 342.

questions.question: In a row of 37 students, Ravi is 18th from the left. What is his position from the right?
questions.explanation: Position from right = 37 − 18 + 1 = 20.

questions.question: Find the next term: 49, 64, 81, 100, 121, ?
questions.explanation: These are perfect squares 7²…11². Next is 12² = 144.

questions.question: Find the next term: 2, 5, 11, 20, 32, ?
questions.explanation: Differences increase by 3 each step; next difference is 15, so 32 + 15 = 47.

questions.question: If BOOK is coded as CPPL, how is TREE coded?
questions.explanation: Each letter is shifted forward by 1. Applying the same to TREE gives USFF.

questions.question: What is the angle between the hour and minute hands of a clock at 4:00?
questions.explanation: Each hour mark = 30°. At 4:00 the angle is 4 × 30° = 120°.
